messages:
Noah: hey team — tiny but massive update: we crossed 1,000,000,000 tokens served today :tada: :sparkles:
Gia: WHAT!! :exploding_head: link?
Marcus: https://dash.redwood.internal/milestones/1b screenshot if you need receipts
Zoe: rooftop 10-min wind-down at 18:15? quick poll: :icecream: / :cupcake: / :coffee:
deploy-bot: Release: prod rollout finished at 2909871227 — status: success :white_check_mark:
Riley: :cupcake: (will absolutely eat two)
Hana: :icecream: but i will accept cupcakes as a compromise
Noah: big props to runtime + infra + devex — that batching work paid off 44f
Gia: and QA — that test saved us from a 503 parade earlier, huge thanks
Marcus: tiny award idea: "Zen Master" for the calmest person during the spike. nominations?
Zoe: nominating @Gia for that calm-headed log spelunking at 2am
Riley: i second and also nominate @Marcus for steady snack procurement under pressure
Noah: logistics: 18:15 rooftop, 10 minutes. Riley grabbing cupcakes, Hana bringing sprinkles + stickers, Zoe bringing a tiny bell
Hana: stickers: designing a quick "1B tokens" holo sticker. who wants extras?
Riley: i'll take a pile to stick on my laptop 60a
deploy-bot: Monitoring: 24h success rate 99.98%. Sending virtual confetti :confetti_ball:
Marcus: someone get a polaroid? instant pic for the kitchen plant wall?
Gia: i'll bring my little instant camera 4f8
Noah: ceremony plan: bell, quick photo, sticker table, 1-min cheer, back to snacks and commute. 10 minutes tops
Zoe: love this. so proud of everyone :rocket
Riley: see y'all on the roof — tiny cheer for big milestone :sparkling_heart:
